name: Ricardian contracts

subjectOf.text: Because of the fees attached to its extra verification layer, the OpenBazaar dispute resolution mechanism creates substantial transaction costs that pure Ethereum based self executing smart contracts avoid.
subjectOf.abstract: Because of these fees, the OpeanBazaar dispute resolution mechanism creates substantial transaction costs that can be avoided by pure Ethereum-based self-executing smart contracts.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Craig Calcaterra, Crypto Transaction Dispute Resolution (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2992962
scope_conditions: Ricardian contracts that attach a notary to every contract

subjectOf.text: Dual integration, as the authors define it, is the use of legacy legal infrastructure in smart contracting dispute resolution, such as Ricardian contracts, in combination with intra-blockchain systems for resolving smart contract disputes.
subjectOf.abstract: Dual integration refers to the use of legacy legal infrastructure in smart contracting dispute resolution, such as via the Ricardian contracts, among other measures, in combination with intra-blockchain systems for the resolution of smart contract disputes.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Craig Calcaterra, Crypto Transaction Dispute Resolution (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2992962
scope_conditions: the implementation and transition phase of the crypto economy
